set.body: At Reframe4s108028fb7127e71083bb46b5e4c033f831775c0e, typed core/lie maps depend on Image4s-owned Frame/Point/Dim, conflicting with spatial4s1b98abb873543f90a1e532e1a67f39e16c1ba09d neutral authority. User requests unification before dogfooding only the concrete head/device/MRI affine-map need. Image4s aliases will delegate common coordinate types to Spatial4s; retain Image4s grid/image/IO ownership and Reframe typed-map ownership. Qualify core/lie plus relevant downstream consumers, reject wrong live owners, and pin exact canonically integrated dependencies with one Gale and one frame authority. No casts or duplicate ephys transform algebra. Cross-reference ephys4s Mote ephys4s-provider-reframe-spatial-closure and ephys4s-0-spatial; evidence docs/verification/spatial-probe-2026-10-06/ in ephys4s.
set.title: Admit shared spatial types for concrete ephys4s transform consumers
